import arxiv
import json

client = arxiv.Client()

queries = [
    "LLM hallucination self-detection",
    "large language model self-verification hallucination",
    "LLM self-consistency calibration uncertainty",
    "language model factual error detection verification"
]

results = []
seen_ids = set()

for query in queries:
    search = arxiv.Search(
        query=query,
        max_results=15,
        sort_by=arxiv.SortCriterion.Relevance,
        sort_order=arxiv.SortOrder.Descending
    )
    for r in client.results(search):
        if r.entry_id not in seen_ids:
            seen_ids.add(r.entry_id)
            results.append({
                "id": r.entry_id,
                "arxiv_id": r.entry_id.split("/")[-1],
                "title": r.title,
                "authors": [a.name for a in r.authors[:5]],
                "year": r.published.year,
                "abstract": r.summary[:500],
                "pdf_url": r.pdf_url,
                "categories": r.categories,
                "query": query
            })

print(f"Found {len(results)} unique papers")
for r in results:
    print(f"\n[{r['year']}] {r['title']}")
    print(f"  ID: {r['arxiv_id']}")
    print(f"  Abstract: {r['abstract'][:200]}...")
    print(f"  URL: {r['pdf_url']}")

with open("paper_search_results/arxiv_results.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
EOF
